parsed.rationale: All three types — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each independently defines an identical `displayName` computed property at line 41 of their respective files. Introducing a `BlendModeDisplayable` protocol with a default `displayName` implementation in a protocol extension (e.g., in a new `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/BlendModeDisplayable.swift`) would eliminate all three duplicate bodies while preserving per-type conformance. Because the implementations are exact duplicates (`function-duplicates-exact`), a single default implementation can serve all conformers without any specialisation. The `_Plant_` prefix on `_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift` suggests this file may be a candidate for future renaming, making a protocol boundary even more valuable for insulating call sites.
